name: Schema Drift Reviewer
description: Audit database schema drift and safely draft migration PRs using schemadrift
about: Audits PostgreSQL database schema drift across environments and snapshots. Runs schemadrift to catch unindexed foreign keys and missing primary keys, enforces safety approval gates before any destructive drops, and drafts reviewed migration pull requests.
features: Detect schema drift across environments and snapshots
Enforce safety approval gates before destructive drops
Generate transaction-wrapped SQL and draft migration PRs
examplePrompt: Check if staging and production schemas have drifted and draft a safe migration PR.
